parameters.name: ApiMethod
parameters.description: The HTTP method of the API request.

parameters.name: ApiName
parameters.description: The API name. The name is used for fuzzy match.

parameters.name: ApiPath
parameters.description: The request path of the API.

parameters.name: EnableTagAuth
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable tag verification.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: StageName
parameters.description:
The environment in which you want to perform this operation. Valid values:

*   **RELEASE**: the production environment
*   **PRE**: the staging environment
*   **TEST**: the test environment

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags of objects that match the rule.

parameters.name: UnDeployed
parameters.description: Specifies whether to filter unpublished APIs.

parameters.name: Visibility
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the API is public. Valid values:

*   **PUBLIC**: The API is public. If you publish the definition of a public API to the production environment, the definition is displayed on the APIs page for all users.
*   **PRIVATE**: The API is private. If you publish an API group that contains a private API in Alibaba Cloud Marketplace, the API is not displayed in Alibaba Cloud Marketplace.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi describe-apis --group-id c4a4d2de657548a2bd485d5d4df42b4a --api-id f68c19ee3bd1478fb58aa05ce8ae9b5a --api-name weather --catalog-id 1553414085247362 --visibility PUBLIC --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --enable-tag-auth true --tag Value=value Key=key --api-path /illegal/query --api-method GET --un-deployed true --stage-name RELEASE --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi DescribeApis --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key key --EnableTagAuth true --PageSize 10 --ApiName weather --StageName RELEASE --ApiMethod GET --UnDeployed true --CatalogId 1553414085247362 --GroupId c4a4d2de657548a2bd485d5d4df42b4a --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value value --Visibility PUBLIC --ApiId f68c19ee3bd1478fb58aa05ce8ae9b5a --ApiPath '/illegal/query'
